title: Efforts at Engaging Different Groups for Best Way Forward for Section 377A of Penal Code
what_it_is: Efforts at Engaging Different Groups for Best Way Forward for Section 377A of Penal Code

sections.label: Societal attitudes towards homosexuality shifting
sections.summary: The speaker says societal attitudes towards homosexuality have gradually shifted since section 377A was last discussed in Parliament in 2007.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: As I mentioned in Parliament on 3 March this year, since the issue of section 377A was last discussed in Parliament in 2007, societal attitudes towards homosexuality have gradually shifted.

sections.label: Views on section 377A
sections.summary: The Government is speaking with diverse groups, will consider views carefully, and invites Ms Hazel Poa or another Parliamentarian to state their Party's position on section 377A.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: On the one hand, the vast majority of Singaporeans are of the view that heterosexual marriage, between a man and a woman, must remain the bedrock of our society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: On the other hand, many Singaporeans, including some of those who believe in the traditional family structure, feel that private consensual sex between men should not be criminalised.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Government has been and will be speaking with diverse groups of Singaporeans to better understand their viewpoints.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We will consider the various views carefully and assess the best way forward that tries to balance the different viewpoints.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Since this is an important issue, I would like to invite Ms Hazel Poa, or any other Parliamentarian from her Party, basically Mr Leong Mun Wai, to state her or their Party’s position on section 377A.

sections.label: Party lacks consensus on issue
sections.summary: The speaker says the Party has people with different views and no consensus on this issue at this moment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: For us, within the Party itself, we also have people with different views.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: So, this is not an issue that we actually have a consensus on at this moment in time.
